title: Overdrive weekly effort
description: The service's answer to GET /v1/effort?weeks=N (spec §6.3, §8.3, ADR 0042, design/companion.md §4.15, §6.12): the training load of the last N weeks (1 to 52, default 12), summed per local week (Monday to Sunday), with the rider's usual range and a verdict for every week, the days of each week and its activities. Effort is the training load the service already computes (ADR 0022, ADR 0023), not a second formula: the power-based score of a ride on the tablet, the heart-rate score of a workout from the watch or of an outdoor ride imported from a FIT file, on one scale (100 is one hour at threshold); every kind counts, and a watch session that overlaps a tablet ride is not counted twice. weeks are the N weeks ending with the current one, oldest first. A week has weekStart (the Monday), load (the sum of its days' loads), approximate (true when any of its load comes from heart rate, that is from an activity of the watch or an outdoor ride), current (true for the week in progress, the last one only), days (seven, Monday to Sunday, each its date and load; the days after today have load 0) and activities (every ride and workout that started in the week, oldest first: id, kind `ride` for a ride on the tablet and `activity` for a workout of the watch or an outdoor ride, sport (null for a ride; for an activity the type the watch gave it, or `cycling-outdoor` for a ride imported from a FIT file), name, local date, load (null when it could not be worked out: no heart rate or no limits to scale it by, and then it is left out of every sum and share), approximate (true for a load from heart rate) and share (its load's share of the week's load, 0 to 1, three decimals; null when its load is null)). A load is one decimal and every sum is the sum of the rounded figures below it, so what the phone adds up is what the service says. The usual range of a week is the mean minus and plus one sample standard deviation of the loads of the 8 complete weeks before it (the low edge held at 0), counted from the rider's first week with any activity, so a rest week after that counts as the 0 it was and the weeks before the rider started do not count; usualLow and usualHigh are null while the week has fewer than 8 such weeks before it (it is learning). weeksLogged is how many complete weeks of training precede the week, at most weeksNeeded, which is 8; the top-level weeksLogged is the current week's. verdict compares the week's load with that week's own usual range, and for the current week the load so far with the whole range (it can only stay or rise, so `below` there means below so far): `below` under usualLow, `above` over usualHigh, `within` between them, the edges included; `learning` while there is no usual range; `none` for the current week when nothing at all has been recorded in it yet and there is a usual range. The words for the verdicts are the app's. generatedAt is when the service computed the answer (UTC). Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: dates and instants are real; weekStart is a Monday and the weeks follow one another; only the last is current; a week's days follow one another from its Monday, seven of them; every sum holds to the decimal and every share to three; the activities' dates are inside their week and in order; a ride has no sport and an activity has one; a week is approximate exactly when one of its activities is; usualLow and usualHigh are both null or both numbers and low is not above high; they are null exactly when weeksLogged is below weeksNeeded; weeksLogged does not fall from one week to the next; the verdict follows from the load and the range.
